about:
Welcome to The Trail Archive, my personal collection of trail running routes.

These are private records of trails I have personally run. I've decided to share them publicly for inspiration and exploration.

Disclaimer: By using these routes, you acknowledge that trail running is inherently dangerous. These are shared for informational purposes only. You are solely responsible for your own safety, navigation, and ensuring you have the necessary skills and equipment. The author assumes no responsibility for any risks, accidents, or injuries incurred while using these files.

Feedback: If you encounter any problems with this website or the routes provided, please report them to me on Instagram @nurandi or via email at nurandi.mail@gmail.com.
